measures.title: Relocation of the Penobscot County Correctional Facility
measures.summary: Asks whether the Penobscot County Commissioners should be authorized, as required under Title 30-A, section 122 of Maine law, to relocate the county correctional facility and any related buildings to a site outside the county seat.
measures.yesMeans: The County Commissioners are authorized to relocate the county correctional facility and related buildings to a site outside the county seat.
measures.noMeans: The County Commissioners are not given this authorization.
